_comment: Canonical hook wiring for this repo's hooks, merged into ~/.claude/settings.json
{{CLAUDE_DIR}} is substituted with the resolved config dir (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, or
$HOME/.claude) at merge time — do not hardcode $HOME here: the token has to survive
a config dir that is not ~/.claude.
Merging is by exact match on each matcher-group object, so re-running the linker is
idempotent and never touches hook entries this file did not put there. That also
means any edit to a group below strands the previous version in an already-merged
settings.json: bump it in the same commit as a linker run, or prune by hand.
Every hook here is non-blocking EXCEPT guard-trusted-writes.py (denies writes to
Those two sit on the permission path — see decision 023 for why they are on by
default and how to opt out (CC_SKIP_HOOK_WIRING=1).
